syllabus_topics: Java language. Classes, objects, and references. Data types, instructions, operators. Arrays and collections. Inheritance, interfaces, polymorphism. Exception handling. Graphics programming using JavaFX. User interfaces for industrial installations.

Android systems. Application development tools. User interfaces for mobile devices. Database access. Sensor and camera handling. Image processing. Wireless communication with industrial devices. Development of applications for control and monitoring of industrial plants.
assessment_rules: Students are expected to exhibit appropriate ethical behavior. In case of detecting unethical behavior (copying, plagiarism, unauthorized use of electronic devices, etc.), it will be considered that the student does not meet the requirements to pass the course, resulting in a global grade of failing (0.0) for the current academic year. The use of unauthorized electronic devices during evaluation tests is not permitted; introducing one into the exam room will also result in a failing grade (0.0) for the current academic year. This course has a high continuous assessment component throughout the academic activities. For calls other than the May call, and for students who waive continuous assessment, evaluation will take place in the laboratory through the practical development of an application similar to those developed during the course.
